inputs.text: The US has floated a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan, but Iran is coming back hard with five counter-conditions, including demands to halt all action against them, extract compensation, and claim full sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. This is classic Iranian regime behavior, using every negotiation to grab more leverage and threaten a vital global shipping lane that keeps oil flowing to the rest of the world. Israel is right to doubt any serious acceptance and to assert its authority for pre-emptive action to defend its people and borders. The usual claims about power imbalances and structural problems are just progressive cover for excusing hostile actors while weakening America's friends and traditional allies. Real stability comes from strong national resolve and backing those who uphold order, not from chasing institutional changes that reward aggression.
